about: The epistola of the formulary “First Passion Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: Christ, present as the high priest of good things to come, entered once into the sanctuary through a tabernacle larger and more perfect, not made with hands, that is, not of this creation, and not through the blood of goats or of calves, but through His own blood, having found an eternal redemption. For if the blood of goats and of bulls, and the ashes of a heifer when sprinkled, sanctify those who are defiled for the purification of the flesh, then how much more will the blood of Christ, who by the Holy Spirit offered Himself spotless to God, cleanse our conscience from dead works for the service of the living God? And therefore He is the mediator of the new testament, so that, with a death intervening for the redemption of those transgressions which were under the former testament, those called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance, in Christ Jesus our Lord.
